name: tranco (Python package)
what_it_holds: Official Python client for tranco-list.eu: `Tranco().list(date='YYYY-MM-DD')` fetches the archived daily list for that exact date and `.rank('airbnb.com')` looks up a domain's rank within it, plus creation of custom-window aggregated lists.
why_useful: Makes the Tranco point-in-time archive (daily since 2018) machine-pullable in a couple of lines — lets the team reconstruct airbnb.com's, and competitors', domain-popularity rank on any historical date without re-scraping, which is the point-in-time property gap #4/#5 asks for.
themes: Web-traffic estimates and domain ranks: Similarweb scrapers or samples, Cloudflare Radar API, Chrome UX Report popularity rank, Tranco, Majestic Million, Common Crawl host-graph rank
wildcard: a computational social scientist who works with Reddit dumps
wildcard: a sell-side analyst covering online travel who assembles con
why_all: Makes the Tranco point-in-time archive (daily since 2018) machine-pullable in a couple of lines — lets the team reconstruct airbnb.com's, and competitors', domain-popularity rank on any historical date without re-scraping, which is the point-in-time property gap #4/#5 asks for.

Tranco explicitly publishes a dated list ID for every ranking pull, i.e. it is point-in-time by construction (unlike ad hoc Similarweb scrapes) -- lets the team track airbnb.com's and competitors' (vrbo.com, booking.com, expedia.com) domain-rank trend over time as a rough directional web-traffic-share proxy called for in gap #5/#19.
Machine-pullable companion to the Tranco ranking generator above; lets a script reconstruct airbnb.com's rank on any specific historical date for a point-in-time engagement series.

name: similarweb_scraper (wchan757)
what_it_holds: Python + pywinauto scraper that drives a real Windows browser session against similarweb.com to pull a site's estimated visits, rank, engagement metrics (bounce rate, pages/visit, avg visit duration) for a given domain list. No data committed — code only.
why_useful: Similarweb's modeled traffic-and-engagement estimate for airbnb.com/vrbo.com/booking.com is the closest free proxy to actual web-visit volume gap #5 asks for; this is the most-starred (22) of several near-identical Similarweb scrapers found. Per the rules, cataloguing only — not run (non-Airbnb site, so lower ToS sensitivity than scraping airbnb.com itself, but still a scrape of a commercial site's paywalled data and should be a human call before running).

name: crux-cache
what_it_holds: Cached CrUX data for 'all ~18M origins tracked by CrUX' with popularity rank buckets, as CSV files chunked to 25MB for GitHub, refreshed monthly by automation. MIT-licensed repo code; underlying data under CrUX Dataset Terms.
why_useful: Broader origin coverage than crux-top-lists (18M vs 1M origins) — could catch smaller competitor/adjacent sites (Sonder, Vacasa, Hipcamp) not in the top-1M cut, still keyed to airbnb.com rank history for engagement trend (gap #5).
time_coverage: monthly, ongoing (35 commits at time of check)
